import.title: Import holdings
import.intro: Take a screenshot of your holdings from your broker. It is read on this device, and you review every row before anything is saved.
import.consentBody: The server reads the image instead of your device. The top of the image is blanked and the image is re-encoded on your device first. If a cloud vision service is configured, the image may be sent to it, and free-tier services may use what they receive. We keep only the stock list and delete the screenshot right away.
import.reviewHint: Fix anything that looks wrong. Highlighted rows need your attention.

flags.value_mismatch: Quantity × price does not match the value
flags.currency_changed: Currency differs from what you hold
flags.unit_mismatch: Price unit looks wrong (shekels or agorot?)

import.keepOnly: We keep only the stock list. The screenshot is deleted right away.
import.onDeviceNote: On-device reading is private: the image never leaves your phone or computer. The first time, about 15 MB of reading data is downloaded from this site.
import.expires: This draft is deleted automatically on {time} if you do not confirm it.
